title: Lox saddle
content:
# Lox saddle

Type: Tool | Internal ID: LoxSaddle | Source: Workbench | Usage: Transport | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Leather scraps x10, Linen thread x20, Black metal x15

# Introduction

Lox saddle is a craftable item.
Lox saddles grant the ability to ride tamed Lox. To attach, simply put the saddle on the hotbar then activate while aimed at a tamed Lox. The saddle can then be "teleported" to, like a boat rudder, by pressing the "Use" key (E by default). The saddle can be removed from the Lox by pressing Left-Shift + E.

Categorias: Items
